title: Iconography / shared construction grid

location.series: Jessie W. Lee / Verizon Master Brand Redesign

slide_intent: Use common construction references so differently shaped symbols maintain a coherent visual size.
strategic_value: A consistent grid can help Verizon’s person, delivery and location symbols function as one family.
demonstration: Three black icons sit on cyan guides above circular, horizontal-rectangular and vertical-rectangular construction shapes.
practical_value: Compare optical size across circular, wide and tall icons while retaining shared guide positions.

content_islands.name: Finished icon row
content_islands.spec: Align the person, delivery truck and location pin across the upper row.

content_islands.name: Construction row
content_islands.spec: Place the three pale cyan reference shapes directly beneath their related finished symbols and continue the cyan guides through both rows.

reference_purposes.Application: Finished symbols are paired with underlying reference shapes and alignment guides.
reference_purposes.Expression: A consistent black outline treatment connects subjects with different proportions.

ingredient.name: Icon construction guides
ingredient.role: Keep differently proportioned symbols visually coherent.
ingredient.application: Compare circle, wide rectangle and tall rectangle guides when constructing related symbols.
ingredient.scope: The construction examples shown here; the image does not state a numerical grid unit.
